description.value: Thetis Island Marina Pub is a waterfront pub and restaurant at Thetis Island Resort on Thetis Island in the Gulf Islands, reachable by BC Ferries from Chemainus or by seaplane. The kitchen emphasizes locally sourced ingredients from Thetis Island and Vancouver Island, with signature offerings including beer-battered fish and chips and char-broiled burgers, plus an outdoor licensed barbecue area capable of hosting groups of up to 150. The resort complex includes a general store, fuel dock, hotel suites, and marina moorage, making it a self-contained destination for visitors arriving by ferry or boat.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active pub and restaurant at Thetis Island Resort, with phone '(250) 246-3464' and email 'thetisislandresorts@gmail.com' matching OSM tags exactly. The address '46 Harbour rd, Thetis Island, V0R 2Y0' was found only on the website contact page, as OSM carries no address field. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, washrooms specifically for pub patrons, or any cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content.
concerns: OSM carries no address field; address '46 Harbour rd, Thetis Island, V0R 2Y0' was sourced solely from the website contact page.
Thetis Island is ferry-access only (BC Ferries from Chemainus), which limits the audience to cyclists planning a Gulf Islands multi-ferry itinerary rather than mainland touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate full-service pub and restaurant that serves as a natural stop for touring cyclists doing a Gulf Islands ferry-hopping route via Chemainus; the resort's breadth of amenities makes it a notable destination worth listing.
